title: Term-Opening Refund Calculation for Cartwise+ Membership Annual Terms
content:
The term-opening refund on a Cartwise+ Membership annual term that is ended early is the amount below.

## Definitions

- **Opening charge.** The fee charge on the membership whose billing period start is the first day of the current term. The refund is booked against that charge, is returned to the original payment method, and is the member's own confirmation of the early end.
- **Months of the term.** A term has 12 months. A month of the term starts on the same day of the month as the term's first day, and the month in progress counts as started.
- **Unused share.** The months of the term not yet started, divided by 12.
- **Look-back window.** The three months ending today, counted in whole months: a row dated on the same day of the month three months back is not counted.

## The amount

1. The unused share of the term is the months of the term not yet started, divided by 12.
2. The gross opening refund is the opening charge multiplied by the unused share and by an opening retention rate of 90%, rounded to the cent.
3. The member fee waivers received on the member's orders in the three months ending today are totalled and taken off the gross opening refund at a waiver offset rate of 1 (the whole of the waivers); the offset is rounded to the cent. The gross opening refund less the offset, never below zero, is the term-opening refund.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A term that began on 10 January with an opening charge of 86.40; today is 25 March; the member's orders carry fee waivers of 3.99, 5.00 and 2.50 dated inside the three months ending today.

| Step | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Months started | the months beginning 10 January, 10 February and 10 March | 3 |
| Months not yet started | 12 less 3 | 9 |
| Unused share | 9 divided by 12 | 0.75 |
| Gross opening refund | 86.40 multiplied by 0.75 and by 90%, rounded to the cent | 58.32 |
| Waivers in the window | 3.99, 5.00 and 2.50 totalled | 11.49 |
| Offset | 11.49 multiplied by 1, rounded to the cent | 11.49 |
| Term-opening refund | 58.32 less 11.49 | 46.83 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- **On the term's first day.** One month (the month in progress) has started, so 11 months are not yet started and the unused share is 11 divided by 12.
- **Waivers exceeding the gross refund.** A gross opening refund of 8.10 with an offset of 12.00 gives a refund of zero, never a negative amount.
- **A waiver dated exactly three months back.** With today 25 March, a waiver dated 25 December is not counted; one dated 26 December is.
